title: WOFF 1.0 font signature (wOFF)
summary: A WOFF (Web Open Font Format) 1.0 file begins with the 4-byte signature 'wOFF'.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Bytes 4-7: flavor (the original font's scaler type, e.g. 0x00010000 or 'OTTO').
Followed by total length, numTables, and the table directory.
